# `igdev consent`

consent holds the one command that moves Consent between machines. Consent itself is
only ever recorded by a person, with `igdev setup --accept-eula` (ADR 0004).

## Subcommands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`igdev consent export`](consent-export.md) | Export this machine's Consent record for IGDEV_CONSENT_FILE |

## Usage

```text
igdev consent [flags]
```

## Options

```text
  -h, --help   help for consent
```

## Global options

```text
      --config stringArray   override one config key for this run, key=value (highest precedence)
      --json                 emit the JSON envelope on stdout (machine mode)
```

## Agent usage

consent carries a person's Consent record to an unattended runner. It never
records consent: only a person runs igdev setup --accept-eula. Use igdev consent export.
